component: Account Hub custom input public interface

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The wrapper keeps native input internals private and forwards value and valueAsNumber through public getters. The landing uses light DOM and drops copied-event forwarding. Only localization IDs are observed; initial optional attributes copy truthy strings, which skips an empty-valued required attribute. Accepted source later adds a required setter that mirrors the native field, and the outgoing-username caller uses it. Actual templates use required="required". Attribute mutation and property assignment are separate paths; no form failure or event run was reproduced.
title: Account Hub input properties and initial attributes have different forwarding contracts
